profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001768267. On its own site, the company describes itself as delivering trusted physical AI through voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, and agentic architecture, proven at automotive scale and built for intelligent systems across industries. It says its platform combines voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution to help people communicate and collaborate naturally with vehicles, machines, and intelligent systems.

The site describes an agentic cockpit that coordinates specialized agents, vehicle context, and governance for in-car outcomes, and an AI agents ecosystem in which specialized agents share context and coordinate actions using Agent2Agent protocols, with guardrails and privacy controls and a flexible architecture spanning cloud, edge, or hybrid. Named offerings on the site include Cerence xUI, described as a multimodal AI foundation that helps OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which the company says is deployed in production vehicles and can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also discusses AI for automotive dealerships, industrial AI, and work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants.

The site states third quarter results with revenue up 12% YoY, connected services revenue up 20% YoY, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program. The company says leading automakers, technology companies, and enterprises worldwide rely on it. No litigation, MCP servers, or tracked products appear in the record.
